name: New England Style Clam Corn Chowder
ingredientsText: Water, potatoes, clams, non-gmo corn, wheat flour, butter (milk, salt), native tapioca starch, onions, sea salt, seasoned salt (salt, sugar, paprika, turmeric, onion, garlic) and pepper.
notes: Clams are molluscs, not shellfish under the crustacean-only rule.
